ValidationRule.description: Restrict Internal User to Edit Status and Final OMR Meeting Info and allow edit only to Orientation Planner
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Update_Final_OMR_Meeting_Info ) , NOT( ISNEW() ) , ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Orientation_Meeting_Request' ) , OR( ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Cancelled' ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Completed' ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only members of the Orientation Meeting Request queue can update the Status to Complete or Cancelled.
